import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianCandidate
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FiniteSupportFlattening
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FiniteSupportFiberRank
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.GrassmannianCandidateFiniteSupport

/-!
# Relative flattening of the universal Grassmannian candidate

The finite-support rank-stratum construction applies to the actual universal
candidate cokernel. For a line bundle on a proper smooth geometrically integral
curve, the strict section-rank inequality supplies finite support. The result
constructs a locally closed base scheme and gives its
universal property for arbitrary relatively flat tests of fixed direct-image
fibre rank, identified with the dimension of residue-fibre sections. It does
not assume the tests are flat over the Grassmannian.

This is the finite-support part of campaign D3, using Nitsure, Section 4,
toward Kleiman's Section 3 divisor theorem. The Cartier open and divisor
reconstruction remain separate obligations.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Grassmannian

/-- Given finite support of the universal candidate cokernel, its relative
flat degree-`d` stratum exists inside the ambient Grassmannian and classifies
all relatively flat degree-`d` tests. Degree here is the dimension of sections
on the residue-field fibre of this finite-support sheaf. The support hypothesis
is about the cokernel, not its ideal, whose support is generally the curve. -/
theorem exists_universalCandidate_flatDegree_stratum
    {S X : Scheme.{0}} {π : X ⟶ S} [IsLocallyNoetherian S] [IsProper π]
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsFinitePresentation] {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (representingScheme hV hd hdr).left]
    (hfin : IsFinite
      (Modules.schematicSupportι (cokernel (universalKernelEvaluation L hV hd hdr)) ≫
        pullback.snd π (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom)) :
    let G := representingScheme hV hd hdr
    let p := pullback.snd π G.hom
    let F := cokernel (universalKernelEvaluation L hV hd hdr)
    ∃ (Z : Scheme) (i : Z ⟶ G.left), IsImmersion i ∧
      CoherentSheafFlat (pullback.snd p i)
        ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst p i)).obj F) ∧
      (∀ z : Z, p.fiberH0 F (i z) = d) ∧
      ∀ (T : Scheme) (g : T ⟶ G.left),
        (∃! l : T ⟶ Z, l ≫ i = g) ↔
          CoherentSheafFlat (pullback.snd p g)
            ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst p g)).obj F) ∧
          ∀ t : T, p.fiberH0 F (g t) = d := by
  let G := representingScheme hV hd hdr
  let p := pullback.snd π G.hom
  let F := cokernel (universalKernelEvaluation L hV hd hdr)
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := universalCandidateCokernel_isFinitePresentation L hV hd hdr
  haveI : ((Modules.pushforward p).obj F).IsQuasicoherent :=
    Modules.pushforward_isQuasicoherent p F
  haveI : ((Modules.pushforward p).obj F).IsFinitePresentation :=
    Modules.isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite_schematicSupport p F hfin
  refine ⟨Modules.rankStratum ((Modules.pushforward p).obj F) d,
    Modules.rankStratumι ((Modules.pushforward p).obj F) d, inferInstance, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Modules.coherentSheafFlat_pullback_rankStratum_of_isFinite_schematicSupport p F hfin d
  · intro z
    rw [← Modules.pointRank_pushforward_eq_fiberH0_of_finite_support p F hfin]
    exact (Modules.mem_range_rankStratumι_iff ((Modules.pushforward p).obj F) d _).mp
      ⟨z, rfl⟩
  · intro T g
    simpa only [Modules.pointRank_pushforward_eq_fiberH0_of_finite_support p F hfin] using
      Modules.existsUnique_factor_rankStratum_iff_of_isFinite_schematicSupport p F hfin d g

/-- For a line bundle on a proper smooth geometrically integral curve, the
actual universal candidate has a relative flat degree-`d` stratum. Finite
support is produced from the strict section-rank inequality. -/
theorem exists_universalCandidate_flatDegree_stratum_of_curve
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (L : C.left.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d < r) :
    let G := representingScheme hV hd hdr.le
    let p := pullback.snd C.hom G.hom
    let F := cokernel (universalKernelEvaluation L hV hd hdr.le)
    ∃ (Z : Scheme) (i : Z ⟶ G.left), IsImmersion i ∧
      CoherentSheafFlat (pullback.snd p i)
        ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst p i)).obj F) ∧
      (∀ z : Z, p.fiberH0 F (i z) = d) ∧
      ∀ (T : Scheme) (g : T ⟶ G.left),
        (∃! l : T ⟶ Z, l ≫ i = g) ↔
          CoherentSheafFlat (pullback.snd p g)
            ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst p g)).obj F) ∧
          ∀ t : T, p.fiberH0 F (g t) = d := by
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation := hL.isFinitePresentation
  exact exists_universalCandidate_flatDegree_stratum L hV hd hdr.le
    (isFinite_universalCandidateSupport C L hL hV hd hdr)

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Grassmannian

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Grassmannian

variable {S X : Scheme.{0}} {π : X ⟶ S} [IsLocallyNoetherian S]

/-! ## Cartier openness after a base change

The rank stratum constructed above makes the candidate cokernel flat over its
base.  Given any base change `i : Z ⟶ G` (in particular, the flattened
stratum), the remaining Cartier condition is a whole-fibre condition for the
pulled-back candidate ideal.  Applying the proper-image open construction to
that base-changed family gives the maximal open on `Z` on which the candidate
is an invertible ideal.
-/

/-- The maximal open of a base change of the Grassmannian on which the
universal candidate ideal is invertible on every curve fibre. -/
noncomputable def flatDegreeCartierOpen
    (L : X.Modules) [IsProper π] [L.IsFinitePresentation]
    {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r)
    {Z : Scheme} (i : Z ⟶ (representingScheme hV hd hdr).left) : Z.Opens :=
  let p := pullback.snd π (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom
  let M := (Modules.pullback (pullback.fst p i)).obj
    (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr)
  Modules.wholeFiberLineBundleOpen (pullback.snd p i) M

/-- The candidate ideal is invertible over the universal curve above the
flattened Cartier open. -/
theorem flatDegreeCartierOpen_isLocallyTrivial
    (L : X.Modules) [IsProper π] [L.IsFinitePresentation]
    {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r)
    {Z : Scheme} (i : Z ⟶ (representingScheme hV hd hdr).left) :
    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial
      ((Modules.pullback
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd
          (pullback.snd π (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom) i)
          (flatDegreeCartierOpen L hV hd hdr i).ι)).obj
        ((Modules.pullback
          (pullback.fst (pullback.snd π (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom) i)).obj
          (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr))) := by
  let p := pullback.snd π (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom
  let M := (Modules.pullback (pullback.fst p i)).obj
    (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr)
  let q := pullback.snd p i
  have hM : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial
      ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst q (flatDegreeCartierOpen L hV hd hdr i).ι)).obj M) :=
    Modules.wholeFiberLineBundleOpen_isLocallyTrivial q M
  simpa [p, M, q, flatDegreeCartierOpen] using hM

/-- Open-immersion tests of the base change factor through the Cartier open
exactly when the pulled-back candidate ideal is invertible.  Arbitrary test
maps require the separate flat-reflection or range-containment argument in
the subsequent divisor-coverage step. -/
theorem existsUnique_factor_flatDegreeCartierOpen_iff
    (L : X.Modules) [IsProper π] [L.IsFinitePresentation]
    {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r)
    {Z : Scheme} (i : Z ⟶ (representingScheme hV hd hdr).left)
    {T : Scheme} (g : T ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion g] :
    (∃! l : T ⟶ (flatDegreeCartierOpen L hV hd hdr i).toScheme,
      l ≫ (flatDegreeCartierOpen L hV hd hdr i).ι = g) ↔
      LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial
        ((Modules.pullback
          (pullback.fst (pullback.snd
            (pullback.snd π (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom) i) g)).obj
      ((Modules.pullback
            (pullback.fst (pullback.snd π (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom) i)).obj
            (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr))) := by
  let p := pullback.snd π (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom
  let M := (Modules.pullback (pullback.fst p i)).obj
    (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr)
  let q := pullback.snd p i
  change (∃! l : T ⟶ (Modules.wholeFiberLineBundleOpen q M).toScheme,
      l ≫ (Modules.wholeFiberLineBundleOpen q M).ι = g) ↔ _
  simpa [p, M, q, flatDegreeCartierOpen] using
    (Modules.existsUnique_factor_wholeFiberLineBundleOpen_iff_of_isOpenImmersion
      q M g)

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Grassmannian
